# DOPPLER RADAR [italic]Live from the AtmoCast satellite. Live means about nine minutes a day.[/italic]
## HOW TO READ THE RADAR - [bold]Blue streaks.[/bold] Rain. On jungle colonies, all of it. - [bold]White flecks.[/bold] Snow. On ice colonies, this is also the ground. - [bold]Orange haze.[/bold] Dust or sand. Close your vents. Close your mouth. - [bold]Dark swirl.[/bold] Storm. Stay inside, tie down the antenna, and stop sending us tapes of it.
## RADAR RETURNS THIS PASS - Light precipitation over the landing zone. - Heavy cloud building above the processor, which builds its own cloud. That is normal. - A single large return moving slowly through the lower colony at walking pace, stopping and starting. That is probably weather. - Several small returns gathering near the medical block. AtmoCast checked the calibration. The calibration is fine. That is probably also weather.
[color=#8FA8CC]AtmoCast radar is a weather instrument. It is not a motion tracker. Please stop calling the forecasters at night to ask what the returns are. We do not know. We are also at home, with the lights on.[/color]
